title: Mention (call)
description: One tweet in which a shiller posted a contract address (`mentions` table). A "call" in the dashboard is the first mention of a token by a shiller. Source: backend/migrations/0001_init.sql, 0011; pipeline/frontrun_tasks.py.

ca.description: Contract address exactly as in the tweet. The token may not be in `tokens` yet.

token_id.description: `tokens.id`, set once the token is known (the scheduler links late arrivals).

tweet_id.description: X status id. (tweet_id, ca) is unique.

tweet_time.description: When the tweet was posted. Scoring and backtests use this time, never `first_seen_at`.

is_deleted.description: The tweet was later seen as deleted.

source.description: `frontrun_search`: found by searching X for a token's CA. `frontrun_ca_history`: from a tracked shiller's CA history.

first_seen_at.description: When Kairos stored the mention. The gap to `tweet_time` is the collection delay.
